notes: An upload into an encrypted folder, as s3_upload_create.json: size is the encrypted size (16 + plain_size + 16 per 64 KiB), and the parts are the encrypted stream's. enc: the version of the folder's key that the file key is sealed for (the newest: GET /api/keys, or a PIN session's encrypt), the sealed file key and the header. tus takes the same enc as JSON in the Upload-Metadata key enc. Errors besides the usual: 409 encryption_required (a plain upload into an encrypted folder), 409 key_outdated (not the newest version), 409 not_encrypted (a folder that was never encrypted), 400 bad_request (sizes that don't match).
